studies of the State lottery and gaming program that identify certain trends and 5 
emerging technology  to create a safe and transparent gambling environment ; 6 
requiring the Commission to analyze certain technology that may be used by  the 7 
Commission to carry out its duties  in implementing certain provisions of law 8 
concerning sports wagering; requiring the Commission to collaborate and partner 9 
with or contract with certain institutions of hi gher education in the State, 10

Agency or the Director’s designee to collaborate with and participate in c ertain 13 
studies; and generally relating to the State Lottery and Gaming Commission ’s 14 
authority to conduct studies on the use of emerging technology. 15
